mapper.sql: id, `user`, `name`, module, module_name, action, target_id, summary, params, method, uri, ip, success, msg, cost_ms, created_at

where.if: AND (`user` LIKE CONCAT('%',#{kw},'%') OR `name` LIKE CONCAT('%',#{kw},'%') OR summary LIKE CONCAT('%',#{kw},'%') OR target_id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{kw},'%') OR uri LIKE CONCAT('%',#{kw},'%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_audit_log (id, `user`, `name`, module, module_name, action, target_id, summary, params, method, uri, ip, success, msg, cost_ms, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{user}, #{name}, #{module}, #{moduleName}, #{action}, #{targetId}, #{summary}, #{params}, #{method}, #{uri}, #{ip}, #{success}, #{msg}, #{costMs}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM admin_audit_log
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM admin_audit_log WHERE created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
